results.name: AeeRohit
results.text:
finance/tech entrepreneurs starting YouTube channels consistently make same hiring mistake.

they write one job description that needs three people to fulfil it.

senior editor + creative strategist + YouTube growth partner, in one role, at one salary.

every good candidate reads that brief and moves on.

problem isn't budget. it's that no one told them how a content team actually works before they started hiring.

this is consulting conversation that should happen before JD gets written.
